## Details

<a id="set_end_figure"></a>
### [`set_end_figure`](../../../../src/story/end_figure.asm#L6) `$8E17`

*routine*

Runs only when final_stage bit 7 is set. Starts sprites 0-3 from record final_scene_pose of the table $cc9d. The main loop calls it in each pass.

- **Called from:** [`$80FD`](../../../../src/main/main_loop.asm#L29), [`check_final_goal`](final_stage.md#check_final_goal)
